 Predators at Sharks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 15, 2026 
 Link copied 
 PREDATORS (11-4-5) at SHARKS (9-11-2) 
 9 p.m. ET; SCRIPPS, NBCSCA 
 Predators projected lineup 
 Steven Stamkos -- Ryan O'Reilly -- Mavrik Bourque
 Filip Forsberg -- Shane Wright -- Nils Hoglander
 Reid Schaefer -- Alexander Kerfoot -- Vitali Pinchuk
 Ross Colton -- Jack Drury -- Adam Edstrom
 Roman Josi -- Adam Wilsby
 Brady Skjei -- Nick Perbix
 Daemon Hunt -- Jayden Struble
 Juuse Saros
 Justus Annunen
 Scratched: Nicolas Hague, Ilya Lyubushkin 
 Injured: Jonathan Marchessault (lower body), William Trudeau (upper body) 
 Sharks projected lineup 
 Ivar Stenberg -- Macklin Celebrini -- Will Smith
 Mason Marchment -- Michael Misa -- Collin Graf
 Tyler Toffoli -- Ty Dellandrea -- Kiefer Sherwood
 Barclay Goodrow -- Zack Ostapchuk -- Adam Gaudette
 Darnell Nurse -- Michael Kesselring
 Sam Dickinson -- Jacob Trouba
 Dmitry Orlov -- Eric Pohlkamp
 Alex Nedeljkovic
 Yaroslav Askarov
 Scratched: Nolan Allan 
 Injured: Igor Chernyshov (upper body), Alexander Wennberg (upper body) 
 Status report 
 The Predators held an optional morning skate. Saros was their first goalie to leave the ice, an indication he could start. ... The Sharks did not hold a morning skate. Nedeljkovic could start after Askarov made 27 saves in a Sharks 6-5 shootout win against the Utah Mammoth on Saturday. ... Wennberg, a forward, could return after he was unavailable Saturday, when he did participate in the morning skate.
